description: Per-example FitNets hint objective equal to half the squared Euclidean distance between a fixed teacher hint and the student activation after its trainable regressor, summed over activation coordinates. The teacher hint and regressor output use the same nonlinearity (Romero et al., §2.2, Eq. (3)); batch reductions follow implementations/losses/attention_transfer.py:47-52.

examples.title: Train a student regressor to match teacher hints

name: FitNets hint loss

parameters.additional parameters: unsupported; any extra parameter raises ValueError
parameters.ignore_index: must be None because activation targets do not have ignored indices
parameters.logits_or_prediction: floating-point student activation after the trainable regressor, shape [B,...], with B > 0 and nonempty activation dimensions
parameters.reduction: none per example, mean over examples, or sum over examples (default mean)
parameters.targets: floating-point teacher hint activation with identical shape, dtype, and device; detached from gradients
